description: This file declares the InferenceContext class and related structures for managing GPU inference using Metal in TensorFlow Lite. It includes methods for initializing, encoding, profiling, and managing tensors and compute tasks within the Metal GPU backend.

classes.name: MetalNode
classes.description: Represents a computational node in the Metal inference graph, including its task, inputs, outputs, and name for debugging.

classes.name: InferenceContext
classes.description: Manages the state and execution of GPU inference tasks using Metal API, including initialization, encoding, profiling, and tensor management.

methods.name: InitFromGraph
methods.description: Initializes the inference context from a computational graph and model info.

methods.name: InitFromGraphWithTransforms
methods.description: Initializes the context applying specific transformations to the graph before setup.

methods.name: RestoreDeserialized
methods.description: Restores the inference context from serialized data.

methods.name: EncodeWithEncoder
methods.description: Encodes all GPU compute tasks into the provided Metal command encoder.

methods.name: EncodeWithCommandBuffer
methods.description: Encodes compute tasks into Metal command buffers, using separate encoder per task.

methods.name: EncodeWithCommandQueue
methods.description: Queues and encodes compute tasks, batching via encoders.

methods.name: AddResources
methods.description: Adds external resources to the command encoder for profiling or other purposes.

methods.name: EncodeWithICB
methods.description: Encodes tasks using indirect command buffers.

methods.name: Profile
methods.description: Profiles the execution to gather timing and performance data.

methods.name: GetIntermediateTensorsSize
methods.description: Returns total memory size of all intermediate tensors.

methods.name: GetConstantTensorsSize
methods.description: Returns total memory size of constant tensors.

methods.name: SetTensor
methods.description: Associates a MetalSpatialTensor with a tensor ID.

methods.name: GetTensor
methods.description: Retrieves the MetalSpatialTensor associated with a tensor ID.

methods.name: SetInputTensor
methods.description: Sets input tensor data for a given tensor ID.

methods.name: GetOutputTensor
methods.description: Retrieves output tensor data for a given tensor ID.
